notes.title: Added Three new missions! - Update #38
notes.content:
In this update we've included three entirely new missions for you to shoot and spy your way through!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31646421/baa068f3663abadf4f7ad4d4866a0953a001c20e.png[/img]

GONDOLA

In this mission you'll team up with gadget man Smithers, as you navigate the canals of venice. Watch out for the S.C.U.M agents as you traverse the area and avoid those blasted tourist boats!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31646421/a6c5e1f467605096293f55cdfb6b25dad71a6e90.png[/img]

CELLARS

After the gondola you must find a way into the S.C.U.M hidden base, navigate through the cellars, and survive the dreaded S.C.U.M drone testing tunnels.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31646421/dd14fc7c6ae38416c91d85ecc79013047b855469.png[/img]

ARCHIVE

Once you've reached the archives it's a simple matter of collecting any evidence those stupid S.C.U.M have left lying around, of course you'll need to avoid the many machinegun totting badguys, no problem for a secret agent though of course.

We hope you enjoy this update, any problems let us know on the games steam forums!

PSD

notes.content:

First thanks for all your feedback on the games forums! I've done my best to implement some of your requests in this new update. I know some of you want game saves but I'll be adding that later as I'm currently adding more levels to the early game.

I've just uploaded a new version to Steam, v0.77.4. 

This new version features a brand new level, the White house Interior!  I've added this as you guys have requested more content so in the next update I'll also be adding... 

-> Speedboat Level ( The first vehicle level )
-> Beach 2 ( A second beach level )
-> Safe House ( A new hub area with Agent6 )
-> Docks 2 ( A second beach level )

Here's a list of all the fixes/changes in v0.77.4

****MAJOR FIXES****

Added White House level,
Added pause function, ( You can now pause the game with ENTER)
Added onscreen Objectives function, (Press TAB to view Objectives)
Stripped and overhauled mouselook code, (Mouseaim is changed)
Recoded and improved Jumping, (You can now forward-stand jump also)

****MINOR FIXES****
Added flash effect to pots at office,
Fixed occlusion on training area,
Added flash effect to dummies,
Improved snooker table physics,
Added new dialog to mines,
Added new breakable planks to mines, and near bomb,
Moved minecart on mines secret room to side for flow,
Added destructible ceiling to mines intro cutscene,
Increased jump height,
Made headBob slower,

Any problems let me know on the forums! Or leave a comment below.

PSD
